urls.summary: URL coverage proven end to end. (1) New `tools/url-coverage.mjs` parses the Screaming Frog crawl (350 rows, multi-line CSV), fetches the live page sitemap read-only (40 URLs, 21 not in the crawl), docs/migration-map.md, payload-lite live_paths + media-index served_full_url, redirects.json + the plugin seed list and tools/url-matrix.sh, and writes docs/reports/url-coverage.md: 371 rows (24 pages, 16 registry pages, 2 author archives, 48 http→https host redirects, 88 image originals/-scaled, 38 -WxH medium renditions, 84 FooGallery cache thumbs, 71 Avada/plugin/core assets), each with type, live status, post-migration expectation and how it is verified; every image URL resolves to a live:media:<id> record (originals by live_path, -scaled by served_full_url, -WxH by base path, cache thumbs by FooGallery's dir naming) and the consistency checks pass. (2) Author archives: /author/admin/ and /author/hk9director/ → 301 / added to Redirects\Store::seeds() and payload-src/records/redirects.json; seeded on the main stack with `wp hk9 redirects seed` and verified with curl (301, X-Redirect-By: hk9-legacy, Cache-Control public; ?author=1 and unknown authors stay 404; query string preserved) — the resolver on parse_request prio 1 wins over Privacy::block_author_query. tools/url-matrix.sh extended (all 19 crawled pages were already there; added the two author rows + /?author=1 404) and run on the main stack: 84 ✅ / 0 ❌. (3) New re-runnable plugin/heartland-k9s-core/tests/url-coverage-suite.sh: brings the fresh stack (8095) up clean, rebuilds the old live site (all 40 pages with live ids/slugs/parents/templates, all 244 attachments with live ids at their live paths copied from payload/media, core sizes + -scaled generated, second author, old menu, reading settings), installs plugin+theme from build/*.zip, copies payload-lite into the container, runs preflight/dry-run/import with --adopt-existing (244 adopted, 0 fails), then curls every URL: 24/24 pages, 16/16 registry paths 301→/barkode/…/→200, 2/2 author archives, 126/126 crawled image URLs 200, 84/84 FooGallery cache thumbs reported separately (absent, not in the payload), 799/799 upload URLs referenced by the new theme output resolve (none under /uploads/cache/), url-matrix 84 ✅, debug.log clean; results written into the report; stack torn down with down -v. Final recorded run: 34 passed / 0 failed. A second run with a plugin ZIP built from the working tree passed the seeded-rules path (34/34, "seeded by the plugin"). docs/migration-map.md: two outdated rows corrected (author archives now Redirect; uploads paths identical in adoption mode) and a "URL coverage" section appended with the numbers.

seo.summary: Implemented the SEO + structured-data area end to end. New plugin module `HK9\Core\Seo` (Module, Detector, Context, Description, Image, Head, Schema, Breadcrumbs, Fields, Sitemap; registered in Plugin.php MODULES after Analytics). Detection of Slim SEO / Yoast / Rank Math / AIOSEO / SEOPress / The SEO Framework yields 'full' vs 'plugin-managed' mode (Settings → SEO selector auto|full|plugin|off with a rendered status note). Full mode prints document title parts (SEO title field replaces the title; posts page = blog.hero_title; Page N kept), meta description (field → excerpt → hero/mission text → team/campaign summary or story quote → first paragraph ≥40 chars → tagline, trimmed ~155 chars at a word boundary), self-referencing canonical incl. /page/N/ (core rel_canonical removed; field override), wp_robots noindex,follow for the field/registry/fixtures, rel prev/next on paged listings, full Open Graph (1200×630 'hk9-og' crop registered at init, alt/width/height/type, article:* on posts) + Twitter cards, and one JSON-LD @graph (NGO with legalName/alternateName/logo/address/telephone/email/nonprofitStatus/taxID/sameAs/contactPoint/DonateAction, WebSite+SearchAction, WebPage/CollectionPage/AboutPage/ContactPage/SearchResultsPage, BreadcrumbList, BlogPosting, Event on singles + the events listing with timezone-offset ISO 8601 dates and endDate only when set, FAQPage from rendered faq sections, Person ItemList on the people template with no emails, DonateAction on the donate page). Plugin-managed mode prints none of the plugin's tags; the NGO/Event/FAQ/ItemList/DonateAction nodes use Slim SEO's @id scheme and are merged directly into Slim SEO's graph via `slim_seo_schema_graph` (one script, one Organization; verified with Slim SEO 4.10.1 installed temporarily, then removed incl. options), with a separate same-@id graph as the fallback for other plugins (verified with Slim's Schema feature off). Per-post "Search & social" meta box (title/description/social image/noindex/canonical) via the fields framework with registered REST-schema meta, revisions, REST pre-sanitizing and block-editor mirroring; shows a note in plugin-managed mode. Core sitemap in full mode: editorial types listed, noindexed posts + fixtures excluded, lastmod on post/front/term entries. Theme: compat.php now delegates to the plugin (minimal plugin-less fallback kept), new inc/seo.php + template-parts/breadcrumbs.php (Home › Section › Page, small muted trail, aria-current) placed inside the content card on default/landing pages, in story/team/campaign/event singles and posts; SCSS in _pages-shared.scss; CSS rebuilt. Payload settings.json gained the seo group (mode auto, default social image = hero-home token, same_as = Facebook + Candid, breadcrumbs on). Docs: docs/seo.md (new), admin-guide SEO section, ARCHITECTURE §2/§7/§11/§12. tools/schema-check.mjs written and run: 29/29 URLs pass in full mode, 10/10 with Slim SEO merged, 3/3 fallback; Lighthouse SEO 100 on /, /events/, /donate/. Plugin-less theme verified on the fresh stack (torn down afterwards). All tmp objects removed and local settings restored.

perf.summary:
Performance pass on the theme (area: assets.php, setup.php, template-tags.php image helpers, theme.js, generated font partial) with measured proof. Mobile Lighthouse (median of 3, same tool/settings, same local stack): / 94→99 (LCP 3.08→2.25 s), /about/ 96→99, /program/ 96→99, /contact/ 93→94, /news/ 99→100, /events/ 98→99, /meet-the-team/ 95→99, /photos/ 75→95 (LCP 8.03→2.93 s). A11y/BP/SEO 100 everywhere; CLS 0; TBT 0. Targets met on 7 of 8 pages; /contact/ stays at 94 (runs 94/95/94) because of the Gravity Forms stack (38 kB gzip render-blocking CSS + 117 kB deferred JS incl. jQuery) — experiments show nothing left in the theme on that path; options documented. Home LCP < 2.5 s met.

Changes: (1) WebP sub-sizes via image_editor_output_format (JPEG→WebP; PNG→WebP only for opaque truecolor/greyscale PNGs, palette/alpha PNGs stay PNG), WebP quality 80 (core's 86 gave only −10 %); hero 768w 108→75 kB, about card 87→53 kB, testimonial 59→30 kB, events flyer PNG 628→71 kB. (2) New sizes hk9-tile (512×683 soft) and hk9-portrait-sm (300×400 crop) so gallery tiles have candidates between medium and large. (3) render_block_core/gallery rewrites tile `sizes` from the real column/container widths (measured), using core's own srcset function; photos page eager tiles 2 567→1 055 kB. (4) hero_image.image_mobile rendered as <picture><source srcset sizes> with a matching per-media-query preload (imagesrcset/imagesizes) — verified one hero request per breakpoint; without a mobile image Chrome picks the 768w candidate at 412@1.75. (5) Fraunces italic (82 kB, only used below the fold) removed from the CSS and loaded via the Font Loading API after load + FCP + fonts.ready, with <noscript> and block-editor fallbacks; generator emits fonts.json. (6) Theme CSS (core + bundles) printed inline instead of <link>s — measured meet-the-team 94→99, news 99→100, no FOUC possible; toggle via HK9_INLINE_CSS / filter. (7) Gravity Forms 3.0.1's empty orbital stylesheet (0 bytes, 1 blocking RTT) dropped while the file is empty; verified GF assets load only on form pages. Docs: new docs/performance.md (before/after tables, LCP element per page, bytes, remaining opportunities, re-measure commands); docs/install.md §D.6 hosting/LiteSpeed Cache/purge/Cache-Control/WebP-support guidance. Lighthouse after-run published to docs/reports/lighthouse/report.md (+ baseline report). Screenshot diff vs docs/reports/screenshots/wp/chromium: 0.00 % on 14 of 16 route×width pairs, contact 0.01/0.03 % (pre-existing GF nuance); network audit PASS (16 URLs); axe PASS; debug.log empty; no tmp objects left.

fix.summary:
Applied all four review findings and re-ran the affected checks on the main stack (8093) and the fresh stack (8095, torn down afterwards).

(1) noindex + canonical conflict (Head.php): added `Context::rel_canonical()` / `Context::has_canonical_override()`; `Head::print()` now skips `<link rel="canonical">` and rel prev/next on any singular view where `Context::noindex()` is true (per-post toggle, hk9_barkode records, local fixtures) unless the per-post canonical override names another URL; `og:url` and the OG/Twitter set stay. `Schema::printable()` extends the old hk9_barkode-only guard to `is_singular() && Context::noindex()`, so noindexed pages print no JSON-LD (full mode) and get no extras merged (plugin mode). `tools/schema-check.mjs` gained noindex rows (`--noindex=`, default `/barkode/hk923-005/`; `--noindex=` empty to skip) asserting robots noindex present, 0 canonical, 0 prev/next, 0 JSON-LD. Verified: registry record → `noindex, nofollow` + X-Robots-Tag, 0 canonical, 0 ld+json, og:title/og:url still 1; tmp page 783 (deleted) with hk9_seo_noindex=1 → `noindex, follow`, 0 canonical, 0 JSON-LD; with canonical override https://example.org/elsewhere/ → that canonical printed, 0 JSON-LD; toggle off → self canonical + 1 JSON-LD. docs/seo.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §12 updated.

(2) url-coverage report: `npm run build` + `npm run package` rebuilt build/heartland-k9s-core.zip (now contains src/Seo/ and the Store::seeds() author-archive rules, no tests/) and build/heartland-k9s.zip; re-ran plugin/heartland-k9s-core/tests/url-coverage-suite.sh → 34 passed / 0 failed, Simulation section now records "author archives (301 → /; seeded by the plugin) 2/2", notes [] (the "predates" bullet is gone). Fresh stack and suite temp files removed.

(3) Mixed PNG/WebP renditions: documented as expected behaviour in docs/performance.md §2.1 and §4 (12 of 37 opaque PNGs on the local stack; one-off `wp media regenerate --yes`, or the PNG-only whole-attachment command, makes each image one format again) and docs/install.md §D.6 (Image Optimization bullet).

(4) docs/performance.md §1: note that `/program/` (page 290, Program template, image hero) is the reference-template page while the migrated live page `/the-service-k9-program/` (page 282) renders the band hero with no image (text LCP) — verified by curl (hk9-hero--image + image preload vs hk9-hero--band, 0 preload).
